current_official_findings.verified: Composite DTM 1m WCS is documented as a persistent WCS 2.0.1 endpoint; WCS is explicitly for raw pixel data such as elevation and can be used with a chosen extent.

Current dataset remains ~99% England coverage at 1m, EPSG:27700, bare-earth DTM produced with algorithmic and manual surface-object removal, +/-15cm RMSE; 2022 composite uses survey metadata index to identify source survey by location.
Terrain50 grid is 50m post spacing, supplied in 10km tiles, and verified at 4m RMSE; retained as secondary crosscheck only.
Each 10km grid tile is 200x200 50m pixels; each height is calculated from pixel centre and reported to nearest 0.1m; archive includes ASC/GML/PRJ/aux XML and per-tile metadata.

Horizontal coordinates are OSGB36 Eastings/Northings; most areas use Ordnance Datum Newlyn, while a small number of offshore islands use local datums, so blanket ODN promotion is forbidden outside verified target metadata.
